reviews.review_description: The salesman was great; he was flexible with options on panels and inverters, as were the other two recommended companies.  I made changes to my requirements and they were quickly updated.The office manager was also very friendly and kept us informed of all developments.The installation was scheduled for a little more than a fortnight but changes in their workload allowed us to get them installed a week earlier, which we were most pleased with.The guys arrived on time, were very friendly and professional.  We could not fault them.Sparkwire sent our details to our energy supplier, requesting a smart meter, and we were informed of the telephone number to ring and sort out our connection.  It would have been nice if we were provided with all the details on what the following chain of events would be and the approximate timeline, and what we needed to do.

Sparkwire Solar have installed systems at 2 addresses for me.  Their service is first rate from the initial enquiry through to installation and ongoing follow-up.Prompt communication, knowledgeable, sound advice, quality products, competitive pricing, excellent installation. All completed seamlessly.  Very happy customer.

Sales process was super easy. Paul was doing my quote after 10pm at night. Amazing service and communication. Installation was fantastic. I was lucky and got to see some of the work being done on my day off. It was very professional and efficient. The guys or site were very nice. Catherine took care of everything for me and the whole process was simple. Catherine provided me with extremely amazing service and the response times to my questions was super fast. The service was lovely. My whole experience was amazing.

Excellent installer good quality installation and quality hardware, they took care of everything and in one day and  halve they  install and commission  24 solar panels   in a two story building and everything is working perfectly.

We couldn't be happier with the customer service starting with Paul Mills who contacted us immediately and we were discussing options within days.  Catherine who handled all the logistics pre during and post installation has be truly fabulous too.  Torsten who owns the business employs highly capable installers.

I am very satisfied with the way in which Sparkwire handled my solar enterprise. Their sales person Paul was very helpful and patient with all my various enquiries throughout the process. He has also explained and assisted with my solar app as well. Everyone else at Sparkwire was similarly professional and helpful.If only I could say the same for AGL who are being the exact opposite and making my venture into solar much less happy and taking cynical advantage by upping my usage rates!BTW, I know nothing about the qualitybofnthebsystem, as have nothing to compare it with. But anyway - Thanks Sparkwire for a good job.
Good communication.Installation was a bit slow as the panels weren't delivered on time and had to be couriered and only arrived in the afternoon.The installers were polite and tidy.

Good service, replied promptly, Arrived when the said they would .Installation carried out efficiently and with minimal interruption to service.still waiting on the meter change over to be carried out by the electricity supplier.

SparkWire Solar's quote was not the cheapest; however, the components that they supplied had better reviews than the others. The SpankWire Solar's installation team were flexible due to inclement weather and worked between my install and another to get the job done within 8 hours. Their customer support was excellent and returned all of my communications within 2 working hours. SpankWire didn't organise the solar grid connection, but they provided all the information, including the blurb, to organise the connection. Overall SpankWire's performance was good throughout the whole process from initial quotation through to installation.

My husband and I are thrilled with the outstanding service and support we have received from Sparkwire Solar. From beginning query to switching on our system today Paul and Catherine have been present, responsive and so easy to deal with. No question was too silly, no request too hard and they have taken the time to explain it all to us. Highly recommend for anyone embarking on a solar journey.
Hi. If you’re looking for solar do yourself a favour and contact Sparkwire Solar. Great local company, great service and easy to deal with

Three quotes, with only one provider turning up to inspect the site. On provider contacted me by phone and one failed to turn up, attempting to contact me 2 hours after the appointed meeting time. Disappointing. The quote I accepted was reasonable, within budget, installed 2 weeks ahead of time , quick, good crew. Would I recommend Sparkwire? Why not!

The whole processed moved smoothly and on time. All my questions were answered in a sincere and helpful way with my interests at heart. Installation was completed by 1pm! The installers arrived on the job before the 7am schedule and worked non stop until the job was complete. Again all my questions were answered, they were very mindful to ensure everything was kept tidy and left nothing behind.  The service was excellent, they did not leave until everything was working the way it should. VERY HAPPY with it all.

The team at Sparkwire were all friendly and punctual.Sales team kept me informed of each step along the way and just made the whole process easy and simple.The install team were great.So happy with my purchase. I'd definitely use them again. Highly recommend them.

No sales pressure, provided several options and quotes to suit my requirements,very knowledgeable and helpful.The installation was prompt and the installers worked tirelessly till the installation was completed on the same day and also checked with me on certain aspects of the job during installation.Great to see the business owner on site assisting with the install.The sales person and admin were great communicators from start to finish and beyond.

We recently had our solar installed by Sparkwire Solar and we would highly recommend them to anyone looking to install solar.Paul Mills came to our property and recommended the best system for our needs. He listened and was very knowledgeable on all aspects of solar.Catherine in the office organised the installation and kept us informed every step of the way. She has also followed up after the installation and nothing has been to much trouble for her.The guys doing the installation were great and everything ran like clockwork. Definitely not a company that will just take your money and run, they care about getting everything in regards to your installation working perfectly.Do yourself a favour and get them to quote on your solar installation.

The sales/quoting process was great I really was pleasantly surprised. It’s wonderful have someone listen to you and give a honest quote.The installation could not of gone any better top quality service and top quality results.I would say the customer service is one of the best experiences I have had. True professionals and I will recommend this fantastic company to everyone.
The whole process was hassle free, there was always someone available to answer my technical questions and the installation went without a hitch.

Sparkwire were professional and very helpful at all levels of installation and after sales service. The installers arrived exactly on time, and were polite, swift, and left the site clean. I would definitely recommend them to a friend.
Great Team.Always helpful.Proactive and keen to help quick at asking all my questions both during and after installation, a great experience.

Sparkwire has exceeded my expectations from day one. I'm so happy with my new system.  I cannot thank you enough Finn for sending Sparkwire my way.  Their salesman was simply outstanding - knowledgeable, always available for questions and extremely helpful. Unsurpassed customer service. I did my own research and was able to confirm what the salesman was telling me. I'm confident I got the absolute best price I could get for my system. The installers absolutely smashed the install - they showed up when they said they would, and they got everything done on the day. I was very impressed. They were professional in their approach and didn't leave a trace that they'd even been there (except for the new system in place of course). Between the time of the purchase and the installation, SolarEdge released a new model inverter and Sparkwire gave me a free upgrade. The administration side of the purchase was very smooth and hassle free, everything went as planned and like they said. Communication throughout the process was excellent. I cannot recall where an operation like this went so flawlessly from start to finish that I'm almost waiting for something to go wrong in the back of my head. But so far, nothing has and I believe nothing will. I COULD NOT BE HAPPIER WITH SPARKWIRE! You should recommend them in all of your future quote requests.

Sparkwire installed our rooftop PV system a couple of months ago. It's been running without a hitch. They were never less than prompt and professional, from taking us through the different layout and inverter options to getting the paperwork done and dusted. I've heard many stories about installers being slow to respond, missing steps, not tidying up afterwards - there was none of that. The communication was particularly good, and a big reason why we chose them over other suppliers. The price was very reasonable too (we opted for Fronius).
Very customer orientated from beginning to end. Punctual, courteous and a great job all round.  No questions unanswered and a real pleasure to deal with. Will happily recommend to others.

The team at sparkwire solar made the installation process as easy and seamless for us as possible. From the point of first contact to the day of installation they kept us in the loop. Sparklers are professional, courteous and very good at what they do.

Outstanding service from the first enquiry to post installation.All early queries were handled professionally and courteously.Installers arrived at 7am and left at 1pm with the site perfectly clean and tidy.Customer service was 100% in all facets from pre to post installation including grid connection.

Great solar company! Outstanding service from Paul Mills in sales who was very knowledgeable and did not make me feel pressured at all with the quote.The professional team of electricians and installers were very organized & prompt.Last but not least you could not find a more helpful person that goes above and beyond in after sales service follow up is Catherine who runs the office.I have had two solar systems installed and will highly recommend them to family, friends and anyone who asks about our solar system or mention they are interested in getting a system installed.it was a stress free experience!

My wife and I aren't the most informed when it comes to Solar energy, but after speaking to the team at Sparkwire Solar, the service was both informed and honest, with a good price. Three massive ticks. We had spoken to a few other companies, but from the top down, this great local company clearly operates with customer service and honesty at the forefront of what they do, and it shows.The installation was fast, the tradies were all good guys (even saw them having a friendly chat with the neighbours) and unlike some we have had working at our place recently, the place was left tidier than they probably found it! Well done lads! And the job was done in little more than a day. Couldn't believe it.The customer service stands out with these guys, and it doesn't end with the front of house staff, everyone exhibits the same standards and it was greatly appreciated. In terms of getting connected, I had a connection instruction email within minutes of the job being completed. They have recently checked back in with us, which was also appreciated and above and beyond what we expected.Well done Sparkwire team, I won't hesitate recommending you to anyone looking for a Solar installation in the local area.All the best guys, Sandy
Guys came to site for a look, explained details and later install went ahead ahead of schedule, professionally and promptly, great job!!!

Quote was detailed and considered aspects I would not have thought to ask about.Installation all done in a day and no mess or fuss.  System has worked as promised from day 1.Already had grid connection but got advice on info needed for contacting electrical supplier (Origin)
Very happy with, sales and install, helped organize grid connection. Would recommend

I was very pleased with Paul Mills who contacted me first by email and then because of Covid he arranged half a dozen quotes of various system options for my specific needs. We arranged a covid safe meeting at the house and he reviewed the options that I liked best and helped guide me through the pros and cons. He was very educational and armed with the information from your quote site (so useful!) I was able to make intelligent decisions.The installation crew worked to get the panels up even sooner than promised with great communication letting me know what to expect when. They left the site and roof tidy and complete when they departed and even did a double check on my TV reception after needing to move the antenna.The office staff was cheerful with good information and assistance with my electric company. I felt I was in good hands all the way through.Thank you for your site and all the info you provide to solar noobs like me. I learned heaps and now I hope the politicians donâ€™t foul it up!
Good. All of the above. The whole job was carried out over 2 days (morningâ€™s). In extreme weather conditions (heat).When system came online it all worked, and all explained to us.
Fast, friendly service! Everything organised with power supplier. Office lady polite and informative. Friendly install.
Did everything they said they would on time. Polite and friendly staff. A painless, stress free experience. Would certainly use them again or recommend them to friends.

The whole service from the initial quote, purchase, administration and installation was a very smooth process. The Sparkwire Team provided a personalised service which I appreciate. I would certainly have no reservation in recommending SparkWire Solar. Regards Paul

Sparkwire Solar provided great customer service throughout the whole process. The sales person was exceptional, very knowledgeable and attentive without being pushy. The installation was smooth and punctual even though the weather wasn't the greatest on the day. The only down side was that the installers left bits of cable ties, pieces of broken roof tiles and metal fillings on the roof and in the gutters which isn't the greatest when all that washes into your rainwater tanks
Very helpful team answering our queries to ensure we understood what we were installing.
From the sales person to the administration staff to the installers, the process was seamless and customer service was superb. The system was well priced and I would (and already have) recommended.
Sales person was friendly and gave us a great deal. Installation was quick and high quality workmanship.

The process was very smooth. We felt reassured that we had made the right decision and that everything had been explained to us. We also didn't feel pressured to make a decision on the day, but we felt very confident to do so.They were very considerate of the fact that there would be some delay as we needed to move our meter board and the communication was excellent.

Great installer from start to finish they were factual, on point and very easy to work with. Communication was wonderful we were kept informed and  they listened to our wants and requests, appointment times were kept. The installers were    polite, neat and tidy in their work overall a good experience looking forward to seeing my next electricity bill.
Sales process was informative and easy to understand with no pressure to purchase.The installation was quick and professional. Excellent communication from the installers.Customer service was A1
All was done professionally, very happy and good knowledge. Very polite.
These guys were brilliant. The whole process was seem less. From and marketing through to the installation. Professional, attentive, punctual!! A brilliant team

Very impressed with the customer service from the entire Sparkwire team. Paul, Catherine and Torsten have been a dream to work with from day 1. Always an email or call away. They delivered a quality product on time, clean, neat, tidy, professional and punctual. Highly recommend and a great price.
Prompt response from the request for quotation through to installation. The personal service that you receive from dealing with a small owner operated and locally SA owned company.
